messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I found an OpenAPI vs site mismatch for POST /v1/embeddings. OpenAPI (openapi/embeddings.yaml) defines request body as { \"input\": string[] } but the docs example uses \"text\": \"single string\". I opened issue #489 and started a branch.
Evan: oof. That will break generated SDKs. Thanks for flagging. Can we keep a short migration note? Some users might still pass \"text\".
Maya: runtime accepts \"text\" and maps it to \"input\" server-side, but docs should be canonical. I'll add a migration note: \"If you previously used 'text', you can pass a single string and the server will accept it; prefer 'input': [ ... ] going forward.\"
DocsBot: lint: openapi/embeddings.yaml: requestBody.schema.type mismatch (expected array for input). docs/_snippets/js/embeddings.md: example uses model not model_id. docs/_snippets/go/embeddings.md: example expects string input but unit tests assert array.
Priya: JS SDK snippet needs updating to: client.embeddings.create({ model_id: 'redwood-2.7b', input: ['hello world'] }). Also update example response to include \"model_details\": { \"name\": \"...\", \"version\": \"...\" } — we added that attr to responses last quarter.
Alex: I'll update the OpenAPI file and regenerate the snippets with make openapi-generate. Plan: change embeddings.yaml input schema to type: array items: string, update examples accordingly. Will push a PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/857) in a few minutes.
Jess: Small nav fix: the old path /docs/reference/embeddings -> now /docs/api/embeddings, add redirect in netlify.toml. I'll add that in a follow-up commit.
Evan: Also check the examples that show curl Accept and Content-Type headers when returning csv/text. One snippet currently sets Content-Type: application/json but then prints CSV sample — mismatch.
Alex: Proposed curl (will include in PR):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_id":"redwood-2.7b","input":["fast inference","low latency"]}'
```
Alex: Proposed response example:
```json
{
  \"object\":\"list\",
  \"data\":[{\"object\":\"embedding\",\"embedding\":[0.0012, -0.0034, ...],\"index\":0}],
  \"model_details\":{\"name\":\"redwood-2.7b\",\"quantization\":\"q4_0\",\"version\":\"2026-01-15\"},
  \"usage\":{\"input_tokens\":9,\"total_tokens\":9}
}
```
Priya: I'll update the JS and Go snippets and add a tiny unit test to docs CI to validate examples against the OpenAPI schema (using openapi-cli validate).
DocsBot: PR #857: checks: openapi-generate OK, docs build queued -> https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/2354
Maya: LGTM. Merge after CI green. I'll re-run site preview and confirm snippets render correctly on staging.
Alex: Merged and deployed to staging; leaving the thread open until nav redirect proves live :shipit:
